public class FT_Size_Metrics extends Struct<FT_Size_Metrics>
struct FT_Size_Metrics {
    FT_UShort x_ppem;
    FT_UShort y_ppem;
    FT_Fixed x_scale;
    FT_Fixed y_scale;
    FT_Pos ascender;
    FT_Pos descender;
    FT_Pos height;
    FT_Pos max_advance;
}

  • Constructor Details

    • FT_Size_Metrics

      public FT_Size_Metrics(ByteBuffer container)
      Creates a FT_Size_Metrics instance at the current position of the specified ByteBuffer container. Changes to the buffer's content will be visible to the struct instance and vice versa.

      The created instance holds a strong reference to the container object.
